items.title: Kyle Monangai: Will suit up Sunday

items.title: Carson Wentz: Will start Sunday at Chicago
items.description:
Coach Kevin O'Connell said Friday that Wentz will be the Vikings' starting quarterback Sunday at Chicago with Kyler Murray (concussion) ruled out for that contest.
